## 📉 Sprint Risk Predictor — Setup Checklist

1. **Schedule Trigger**: Defaults to weekdays at 09:00 and 14:00. Edit the cron expression to match your team's cadence.
2. **Configuration node**: Set `jiraDomain` (e.g. 'acme' for acme.atlassian.net) and `boardId` (find it in your Jira board URL) and adjust `inProgressThresholdHours` (default 48h).
3. **HTTP Request nodes (x2)**: Select your `jiraSoftwareCloudApi` credential (or a Jira Basic Auth credential using an API token) on both.
4. **Slack node**: Select your `slackOAuth2Api` credential and choose the Product Owner / Scrum Master channel.
5. **Send Email node**: Select your SMTP credential and set From/To addresses.

No code changes required beyond these credential/field selections.

nodes.name: Mid-Sprint Schedule
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Default cron runs twice daily on weekdays (9am & 2pm). Adjust the cron expression to fit your team's mid-sprint cadence.

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE (required): Set jiraDomain to your Atlassian subdomain, boardId to your Scrum board's numeric ID (visible in the board URL), and inProgressThresholdHours to your team's 'stuck ticket' threshold.

nodes.name: Get Active Sprint
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Select your Jira Software Cloud credential. Retrieves the currently active sprint on the board configured above.

nodes.name: Extract Sprint Details
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Pulls the first active sprint's ID, name, and start date to compare against ticket timestamps downstream.

nodes.name: Get Sprint Issues + Changelog
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Select your Jira Software Cloud credential (same as the previous HTTP Request node). Fetches all issues in the active sprint with full status-change history.

nodes.name: Analyze Scope Creep & Stagnation
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Flags two risk types: (1) tickets created/added after sprint start (scope creep) and (2) tickets that have sat 'In Progress' longer than the configured threshold, using Jira's changelog history.

nodes.name: Any Risks Detected?
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. True → sends the risk digest to Slack and Email. False → workflow ends quietly with no noise for a healthy sprint.

assignments.name: slackText
emailHtml
assignments.value:
=

Sprint Risk Digest — {{ $json.sprintName }}

Total issues: {{ $json.totalIssues }} | Scope creep: {{ $json.scopeCreepCount }} | Stuck in progress: {{ $json.stagnantCount }}

    {{ $json.flaggedIssues.map(i => '
  • [' + i.reason + '] ' + i.key + ' — ' + i.summary + ' (Assignee: ' + i.assignee + ')
    ' + i.detail + '
    • ').join('') }}

Review these with the team before end of sprint to protect the sprint goal.

nodes.name: Format Digest Message
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Pre-formats both a Slack-markdown version and an HTML version of the same digest for the two notification channels below.

nodes.name: Post Sprint Risk Digest
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Select your Slack credential and choose the Channel ID for the Product Owner / Scrum Master (e.g. #sprint-health).

nodes.name: Email Sprint Risk Digest
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Select your SMTP credential, then update fromEmail and toEmail to your Product Owner / Scrum Master addresses (comma-separate multiple recipients in toEmail).

nodes.name: No Risks Detected - Skip Notification
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Sprint is healthy this run — no scope creep or stagnant tickets found, so no notification is sent.
